title: Conflab adopts the core's release: gates before any push, one confirm, one formula writer
status_reason: moved to conflab's own thread on hv's ruling 2026-11-13: conflab#ST0126
objective:
Conflab, before its next release (Q10; design.md section 7; dialog section 6): `bin/.devbin/cmd/release` and `bin/release` retire into the core so gates run before any push, there is one confirm, no `tag -f` and no delete-and-recreate; `cmd/release`'s `update_formula` is deleted and `cmd/.lib/brew` is the one formula writer until the built-in's cask; `bin/.devbin/config.yaml` gains a `release:` block with the sidecars, `test swift` in `test all`, and `after:` for the pkg path and the distribution mirror; the `macos` handler and `bin/macos.d/` stay as a shadow; `.github/workflows/release.yml` is deleted; `docs/releasing.md`, `docs/notes/tn001-macos-release-local-path.md` (closing note). Serves AC-4.3.


Record (vc, 2026-10-31): Conflab's conflab#ST0126/WP-06 is the one place this work is written and claimed; this package points at it and carries the core-side constraints. Corrections from Conflab's inventory (conflab-dc, checked by conflab-vc at ed9efdc6): `test swift` is already in `test all` (config.yaml:148-153), so the clause is that the cut's gate list carries it; Conflab's release docs are `bin/.devbin/help/release.md` and tn001, not a docs/releasing.md; `.github/actionlint.yaml` goes with release.yml and ST0125/AC-02.1 is re-cut in the same change; the after: list opens with the Fly deploy and ends with `use brew` (Conflab vc decision 42, ST0126 D7) and carries the formula and cask publishes; WP-06 is re-cut against D57 to D68 (no ci.base; ST0126/AC-04.3 and AC-06.2 reworded). Core confirmations asked of cc: DEVBIN_RELEASE_CONFIRMED keeps its name and value (the tag) through WP02 (D58), and `release attach --from <dir>` survives WP07 for object: local.
